Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:146240
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 31912 of 2023

Applicant :- Bhupendra Singh
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- L P Sharma,B.D. Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Ajeet Srivastava
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Sri Ajeet Srivastava, Advocate filed his power on behalf of the informant, today in the Court,
which is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri B.D. Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ajeet Srivastava, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Pradeep Kumar, learned AGA for the State.
3.

The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 89 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Kotwali City, District Mirzapur during pendency of the trial.

4. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and according to the FIR applicant enticed away the daughter of the informant.
5.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that entire allegation made against the applicant is totally false and baseless and as per Aadhar card prosecutrix is major girl aged about 18 years.

Bhupendra Singh vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195928029/

sentences.text: However, according to her T.C. at the time of incident she was around 16 years.

He further submits that actually applicant has given Rs. 25,000/- to the informant of the case and when he demanded back his money then instead of returning his money, he implicated the applicant in the present matter.
He further submits that on the instigation of her parents prosecutrix of the case made allegation of rape against the applicant.
He further submits that applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 03.07.2022.

6. Per contra, learned AGA and learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that even as per the applicant he is 37 years old and having two children and prosecutrix in her both the statements recorded under Sections 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C. made allegation of rape against him, therefore, applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.
7. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

8. From the averment made by the applicant in paragraph-18 of the affidavit, it appears that applicant is 37 years old man and father of two children and prosecutrix who is aged about 16-18 years made allegation of rape against him in her both the statements recorded under Sections 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C., therefore, in my view, applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.
9. Accordingly, the instant bail application is rejected.

10. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
Order Date :- 21.7.2023 AK Pandey  Bhupendra Singh vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195928029/
